## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] New catalog resource
- [ ] Catalog correction or link repair
- [ ] CLI, validator, generator, or site change
- [ ] Documentation or maintenance

## Evidence

List the primary sources used for each changed fact. Include the official paper, project,
or repository URL as applicable.

-

If you are an author, maintainer, employee, or otherwise affiliated with a submitted
resource, state that relationship here:

## Checks

- [ ] I searched for duplicate titles, DOI/arXiv IDs, and repositories.
- [ ] Metadata describes only what the linked primary sources support.
- [ ] Summaries are original, neutral, and do not claim unverified performance.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private links, tracking URLs, or copied third-party text.
- [ ] `gr-atlas validate` passes.
- [ ] `gr-atlas build --check` passes after generated files are updated.
- [ ] Tests and static checks pass for tooling changes.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out uncertain fields, deliberate omissions, schema effects, or follow-up work.
